questions.prompt: You're invited to the big Halloween costume party tonight — the reveals are everywhere, and the room is full of capes, masks, and last-minute costumes. You step through the door in your own look. Which party guest are you tonight?

options.text: Charging in first — costume front and center, ready for the reveal.
Wandering slow — taking in every costume, no rush to be seen.
Settled in a corner — watching the costumes parade by.
Bouncing between groups — a little of every conversation.

questions.prompt: A leak tonight says a Persona 1 remake is in the works — a classic from way back, maybe coming back. How does the rumor sit with you right now?

options.text: Still hyped — a remake would be worth the wait.
Patient and steady — I'll believe it when it's real.
A bit flat — leaks come and go, I'm not holding my breath.
Drifting to other games — I'll come back if it lands.

questions.prompt: You're mid-rally on the Switch 2 tonight and the game freezes — right in the middle of a run. What's your call?

options.text: Pushing through — reload and run it back, freeze and all.
Waiting for a smoother patch — it'll still be there.
Lost in the settings — too many toggles, losing the thread.
Calling it — tonight it's more chore than game.

questions.prompt: SNL's Halloween show is on tonight — costumes swapping mid-song, Juliet turning Romeo right on stage — and you're settled in to watch it all unfold. If someone handled the drinks for your watch night, what would you want?

options.text: Virgin or hard — a Moscow mule hits just right tonight.
Something warm and slow — hot chocolate for the whole show.
Herbal tea — winding down while the costumes change.
Whatever's closest — I'm not missing a costume change to pick.

questions.prompt: My Chemical Romance is back on top tonight — a 20-year-old album climbing to number one again, like the old songs never left. What does it sound like around you?

options.text: A bold anthem swelling — the whole room singing along.
A soft hum underneath — gentle, easy, holding the scene.
Bright and singalong — old favorites bouncing all around.
A tense edge — loud, then a quiet you can't place.

questions.prompt: Harryween's final show just wrapped tonight — the last notes fading, costumes still out in the crowd, and the next hour is yours. What do you want the afterglow to feel like?

options.text: Buzzing — still carrying the show, ready for more.
Steady — letting it settle, no rush to move on.
Warming up — getting little things done first.
Scattered — too many photos open, none of them the moment.
